parsed.name: Keithley 2200 系列直流电源
parsed.description: 用于实验室电子设备供电与偏置的可编程直流电源。证据显示该驱动通过 VISA 与 Keithley 2200-20-5 等 2200 系列仪器通信，并支持读取设备信息及相关状态参数。
parsed.description_en: A programmable DC power supply used in laboratories for powering and biasing electronic devices. The evidence indicates VISA-based communication with a Keithley 2200-20-5 or related 2200 series instrument, with support for reading device identity and relevant status parameters.
